decision.next_gate: Use this read-once heldout result as the Lever 2 operating point readout; do not rerun or retune on heldout. The next scientific gate is whether the primary-retention cost of deterministic missing-locator abstention is acceptable.

interpretation.next_action: Record whether the deterministic-abstention primary-retention cost is acceptable; otherwise continue locator materialization before treating this as a deployable Lever 2 channel.
interpretation.result: The accepted partial source-free operating contract abstains on 92/92 heldout OOS rows and retains 0/48 heldout primary rows at the frozen residual threshold.

scope: Read-once heldout application of the frozen best-token follow-up pair residual threshold to the accepted source-free partial surface. Feature-complete rows are scored with the frozen train centroids and calibration residual threshold; missing-locator rows are carried as deterministic abstentions without feature imputation or residual scores.
